notes.title: Morbid Metal Steam Page Update and New Trailer - Games Made in Germany 2024
notes.notes:
Hey everyone,

Felix here, Game Director and founder of Screen Juice, formerly the solo developer of Morbid Metal. I hope you're all doing great!

I'm thrilled to announce that our Steam page for Morbid Metal has just been updated with some brand-new images and an exciting new trailer. This update comes just in time for the Games Made in Germany Steam Event 2024, and yes, Morbid Metal is part of it!

[previewyoutube=otg4GQXRL08;full]
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=otg4GQXRL08[/previewyoutube]

We've been working tirelessly to bring you an intense, action-packed experience, and these updates will give you a fresh look at what we've been cooking up. The new trailer is something I'm particularly excited about – it captures the heart-pounding, metallic mayhem that Morbid Metal is all about.

Also, stay tuned for 14 brand-new minutes of gameplay coming your way in the next few days! It'll be streamed on the Games Germany Sale stream, as well as right here on Morbid Metal's Steam page.

Thank you all for your continued support and enthusiasm. It means the world to me and the entire team at Screen Juice. Since it's been a while since we last showed new footage, we'd really love to know what you think about all the hard work we've put into the project over the past year!

Check out the new images and trailer, and let us know what you think!

Stay metal,
Felix

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1866130/Morbid_Metal
